features: ✅ [Always Stay Connected] – Kids can make HD video calls, phone calls, and voice chats directly from this calling watch for kids. Only paired parent-approved numbers can connect, ensuring safe communication.

✅ [Track Every Step] – With this kids smart watch for boys and girls, parents can view accurate & live GPS location, check history routes, and monitor step counts as an added safety measure via the Sekyo App.

✅ [Safety at Their Fingertips] – One SOS press instantly shares the child’s live location and calls up to 3 trusted contacts. This smart watch for kids girls 9–12 also sends Safe Zone alerts if they step outside defined areas.

✅ [Silent Monitoring] – Stay reassured with this 4G smart watch for kids boys. Parents can control the watch camera from the Sekyo app to see surroundings live, take photos, or hear background sounds through auto call-pickup if kids are not responding.

✅ [Full Parent Control] – With this smart watch for kids, parents can manage everything from the Sekyo app: enable school mode, block stranger calls, find or disable watch functions, or switch it off remotely.
✅ [Good Habits Coach] – This kids smart watch helps build responsibility with reminders for waking up, brushing, school, reading, homework, and bedtime—teaching daily routines in a fun way.
✅ [Learning with Entertainment] – Loaded with 7 educational & math games, selfie camera, alarm, and phone book, this kids smart watch for boys combines fun with safety.
✅ [Compatibility] – This smart watches for kids model works with Airtel, Jio, and VI Nano SIM (4G). Supports both Android and iOS devices. Long battery life, water-resistant, and shock-proof design.
✅ [Warranty & Support] – Every smart watch for kids comes with a 1-year warranty. Doorstep pick-up and drop service is provided under warranty for repair or replacement.
